summary: Iteration 5 — Post-refactor regression validation for Emergent Upsell CRM. Verified the LeadDetail component split (LeadDetail.js orchestrating LeadPanels.js + LeadModals.js), the env-driven demo-credentials (REACT_APP_DEMO_LOGINS), and the backend refactors (import_leads, create_payment_link/_resolve_payment_amount/_create_stripe_link, _seed_demo_leads). Backend: 35/35 pytest tests PASS (100%) including stripe USD preset, INR->USD razorpay conversion, simulate paid -> Won + owner_locked, CSV import, sticky ownership, reopen flow, FX rate edits, coverage, audit. Frontend: LeadDetail renders all sub-panels (account-context-panel, lifetime-revenue, Update card, Notes, Meetings, Payment Links, Activity Timeline). All required data-testids present: lead-detail-name, stage-select, priority-select, region-select, note-input, add-note-btn, book-meeting-btn, send-payment-btn, reopen-btn. Modals work: meeting-modal (meet-datetime/meet-driver/confirm-meeting-btn), payment-modal (pay-provider/pay-package/pay-currency/pay-amount/fx-preview/generate-payment-btn — fx-preview shows '≈ $59 at ₹85/$1 · reported in USD' for INR 5000), reopen-modal (reopen-type/confirm-reopen-btn — confirmed Upsell reopen kept ownership with Dipan and toast 'New Upsell routed to Dipan'). Add Note: appends note instantly. Payment-link generation closes modal, advances stage to 'Payment Link Sent', and adds payment row. LOCKED TO OWNER badge visible on Won-derived lead. Login: typed login + demo-fill-sales-head + demo-fill-agent all work; env-driven demo credentials parsed correctly (diyea@emergent.sh / aryan.f@emergent.sh). Smoke nav: all 9 admin nav items + 5 agent nav items behave correctly; admin-only items (coverage/campaigns/team/audit) hidden for agent. 0 page errors, 0 JS errors during the entire run.
critical_code_review_comments: REFACTOR IS CLEAN: LeadDetail split into LeadPanels.js (LeadContextPanel/LeadMeetingsList/LeadPaymentsList/LeadActivityTimeline) and LeadModals.js (PaymentModal/ReopenModal/MeetingModal) preserves every data-testid; orchestration in LeadDetail.js (~250 lines) is the right call. Zero behavioral regression observed.

Env-driven demo credentials: REACT_APP_DEMO_LOGINS is parsed as JSON in Login.js and rendered as clickable demo-fill-* buttons. demo-fill-sales-head and demo-fill-agent both populate login-email/login-password correctly. Falls back gracefully if env not set (not tested but code path is straightforward).

Backend helper extractions (_resolve_payment_amount, _create_stripe_link, _seed_demo_leads) preserve behavior: Stripe USD preset (upsell_scale = $2500), INR conversion (8500 INR / 85 = $100 USD), invalid amount 400, simulate -> paid + Won + total_revenue_usd, all pass.
